# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 94 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 94

Jesus said: "He who seeks will find, and he who knocks, to him it will be opened."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- Direct parallel to Matthew 7:8 / Luke 11:10 (Q saying); Thomas omits "he who asks, receives"
- **ⲛⲉⲧϣⲓⲛⲉ** / *netshine*: "he who seeks" — the active searcher
- **ⲛⲉⲧⲕⲁϩⲧϥ** / "he who knocks" — the one who knocks at a door
- Thomas condenses the three-part Q saying to two parts (seek/knock), dropping ask/receive
- This may be deliberate: Thomas emphasizes seeking and knocking (active exploration) over asking (petition)
- Cross-reference: Saying 2 (the seeker), Saying 92 (seek and find)
